name: Barrow
tagline: Raid a torchlit hall: swing at monsters, grab the loot, hide your winnings.
core_loop: Reveal one card into the six-card hall, then take one action: grab red loot, fight a black monster with a hand card and the die, stash a card face down for points, or forage from the barrow deck.
win_condition: Highest total rank in your face-down lair (plus 5 per matched spade/club rank pair) when the barrow deck runs out.
